content: {"reasoning":"The CO-50 medical-necessity denial persists after a correction and resubmission, so a formal appeal addressing the payer's invalid diagnosis–procedure pairing with supporting clinical documentation is the next appropriate step. Prior authorization is not required, and this payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. The denial does not establish that the open balance is patient responsibility, so billing the patient is not appropriate.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
